plugin.notes: 2.5.1 fixes "value: Invalid input" after deploying the relay with a Cloudflare token (2.5.0). Also in 2.5.x: pairing codes vanish as soon as a phone pairs, Deploy-button relays are locked to your desktop, tighter relay limits.

relay.notes: Relay 1.2.0: Deploy-button Workers are locked to the first desktop (no one else can use your Worker or its quota), max 4 phone connections per IP, smaller pre-connection buffer.
